en: Black‑and‑white view over a quiet European town street with cobblestones and early‑20th‑century houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. Trees line a small triangular island or square at a fork in the road, with a kiosk or pavilion beneath them. In the distance, two prominent church towers with baroque / neo‑baroque spires and crosses rise above the low roofs. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
